blocks.html: The Reports plugin lets you create, place, edit and upload field reports of many types, using preconfigured or custom templates. After a report is created, an icon marks the spot on the map where it was taken.

slides.title: Open the Reports tool
slides.html: Select Reports from the toolbar. The window lists reports downloaded from the TAK Server plus any local reports on the device. A server connection isn't needed to create a report, but it is required to download, upload, or search for reports written by other users.

slides.title: Choose a report template
slides.html: Select + to open the list of report templates and choose one to start. Each template has predefined fields; any field marked Required must be filled before the report can be uploaded. You can close and save a report locally without filling every field.

slides.title: Fill in the report
slides.html: Complete the report fields — Title, Importance, descriptions, and so on. The local device's Self-Marker is the default location. Select Pan-To to bring the location field into view, and Edit to change the location.

slides.title: Set the report location
slides.html: Set the location with one of: Use my current location, Based on map click, Enter coordinates (MGRS, Deg, DM, DMS, UTM or Address), Use current map view, Define location boundary (draw a polygon), or Define route.
